notes: Background: SlateBridge builds repository analytics and developer productivity tooling for large engineering orgs (mono-repo customers).

Primary ask: enterprise-grade code search + RAG layer for internal engineering docs and code. Embeddings + reranking pipeline must handle large corpus (initial target: 10M embeddings, long-term 50M+).

Latency/throughput targets: 95th perc token/response latency target < 200ms for first-pass embedding similarity (p99 < 500ms end-to-end with reranker), tail latency critical (developer-facing hotpaths).
Cost target: aiming for <$0.002 per query (embedding search + rerank amortized) for >500k queries/day; heavy emphasis on batching & cache reuse to reach unit economics.
Indexing requirements: frequent re-indexing of repos (delta-index every 30m, full index nightly). Need fast incremental embeddings pipeline and invalidation hooks when PRs merge.

Retrieval architecture preference: hybrid approach — bi-encoder for large-scale ANN retrieval + cross-encoder reranker for top-K (configurable topK 10-50). Must support on-the-fly rerank fallback when precision drops.
Model constraints: prefer open models (quantized) for private infra but open to Redwood-verified suggestions; need deterministic outputs for legal tracking of suggestions in code-assistant flows.

Security/compliance: SSO via SAML (Okta), audit trails for query / token-level metadata, KMS integration for key separation, data residency: US-only for initial deployment, potential EU expansion in 2027.
Deployment preference: Private control plane in customer VPC or on-prem appliance for legal/regulatory customers. Must support peered VPC endpoints and private Egress to internal artifact stores.
POC summary: initial 2-week POC to validate throughput, rerank quality, and cost projections. POC dataset: 12 repos (~120GB raw), expected ~11M chunked embeddings after sliding-window tokenization.
